instruction: Read the list of documents the agency must keep on file. List every document that is missing or incomplete, and every document whose last update is more than a year before the reporting period named in the acceptance criteria. For each one write: document name, why it is required, date last updated, and exactly what is missing. Put the ones a surveyor looks at first at the top.
description: Every document not marked complete is listed, and so is every document last updated more than a year ago.
